jobs.title: Senior Consultant, Integrations & Training Specialist
jobs.description:
**This Opportunity**
--------------------

WSP is seeking an Integrations \& Training Specialist to support the Project Finance Strategy \& Development team. This role provides professional training, integration, coordination, and analytical support for enterprise finance transformations, acquisitions, ERP implementations, process improvements, and system\-related initiatives across the Project Finance function.


The Integrations \& Training Specialist will work closely with Project Finance, Operations, Information Technology, Organizational Change Management, and business stakeholders to support the successful implementation and adoption of new systems, processes, and operating practices. This position will assist with training development and delivery, acquisition onboarding, process documentation, change readiness, testing, stakeholder communications, and post\-go\-live support.


The ideal candidate has experience supporting project accounting or finance teams and is comfortable translating complex business processes and system requirements into clear training, documentation, and end\-user guidance. The successful candidate will be able to work independently on defined responsibilities while collaborating with senior leaders, subject matter experts, project teams, and cross\-functional stakeholders.  

  



**Your Impact**
---------------

  

* Develop, maintain, and deliver Project Finance training programs, curricula, and learning materials that support business processes, system implementations, organizational changes, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Facilitate classroom, virtual, and workshop\-based training sessions
* Support enterprise finance transformations, ERP implementations, acquisitions, and business integration initiatives by coordinating training, readiness, documentation, and stakeholder support activities.
* Partner with Project Finance Operations, Information Technology, Organizational Change Management (OCM), and business stakeholders to identify business needs, assess impacts, and support successful implementation of new systems and processes.
* Assist with acquisition onboarding activities by supporting process alignment, system readiness, training delivery, knowledge transfer, and Data conversion activities into WSP Project Finance.
* Assist and maintain business process documentation, standard operating procedures, process maps, Quick Reference Guides (QRGs), job aids, knowledge articles, and other materials that support standardized Project Finance practices.
* Maintain Project Finance training and knowledge management resources within SharePoint and approved collaboration platforms, ensuring content is organized, current, accessible, and aligned with business objectives.
* Prepare and deliver project communications, stakeholder updates, change readiness materials, training announcements, and post\-go\-live support resources to support awareness, engagement, and adoption.
* Apply project accounting and billing process expertise to support operational excellence, identify process improvement opportunities, resolve user challenges, and contribute to the successful adoption and sustainability of Project Finance systems and business processes.

  

**Who You Are**
---------------

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Business, or closely\-related discipline (or demonstrated proven equivalent experience).
* 5 to 7 years of relevant post education experience in accounting, project contracts and change management documents.
* Proficient knowledge of project accounting principles, practices, and methods and their application to project work\-related issues.
* Ability to make technical computations and calculations involving the application of accounting principles, understanding plans and specifications and making factual comparisons to the appropriate regulations and/or contract stipulations.
* Ability to coordinate with various stakeholders and understand contract requirements, scope, and schedule.
* Highly capable interpersonal and communication skills when interacting with others, expressing ideas effectively and professionally to an accounting and non\-accounting audience.
* Highly capable self\-leadership with attention to detail, multi\-tasking, and prioritization of responsibilities in a dynamic work environment.
* Ability to work independently and provide guidance and leadership to junior team or project members, with strict adherence to QA/QC.
* Advanced proficiency with technical writing, office automation and accounting software, technology, math principles, MS Excel, pivot tables, formulas, data format/sort/filter, VLOOKUP, predictive models, and tools.
* Developed critical thinking and problem\-solving skills required to apply learned subject matter and technical knowledge to reach conclusions from testing results, data collation, statistical analysis and arriving at the most effective, economical, and logical solution.
* Ability to collaboratively and assertively work with others such as subcontractors, consultants, and clients on outstanding accounts receivables.
* Awareness of and adherence to WSP USA’s Project Delivery Handbook.
* Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.
* This is a professional role and as such work deadlines and work hours may extend beyond a typical workday.
Occasional travel may be required depending on project\-specific requirements.  
* 

**Preferred Qualifications** 

* Experience supporting training, process improvement, or system implementation initiatives
* Ability to apply basic analytical techniques to support reporting and data validation
* Collaborative approach with the ability to work across teams and disciplines
* Experience administering or maintaining SharePoint sites, document libraries, training repositories, or knowledge management content.
* required).

WSP provides a comprehensive suite of benefits focused on a providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career. These benefits include coverage related to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life; retirement savings; paid sick leave; paid vacation (or other personal time); paid parental leave; and paid time off for purposes of bereavement, voting, and/or attendance at naturalization proceedings.
  

Compensation:
  

Expected Salary (all locations): $77,100\- $122,700
  

WSP USA is providing the compensation range that the company in good faith believes it might pay and offer for this position, based on the successful applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities in addition to internal equity and specific geographic location. WSP USA reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s sex or other status protected by local, state, and/or federal law.

WSP USA reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s sex or other status protected by local, state, and/or federal law.

Dedicated to serving local communities, we are engineers, planners, technical experts, strategic advisors and construction management professionals. WSP USA designs lasting solutions in the buildings, transportation, energy, water and environment markets. With more than 15,000 employees in over 300 offices across the U.S., we partner with our clients to help communities prosper.

Employees are also afforded a comprehensive suite of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, life, and retirement savings focused on providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career.

Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of WSP and WSP will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation – no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**



At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem\-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever\-evolving world of digital marketing.


**Why Join Us**



We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

**Purpose of the Role**



The Customer Onboarding Team's mission is to ensure all clients receive the best customer experience when onboarding to Partnerize and understand the true value of Partnerize to grow revenue.



As a Customer Onboarding Senior Specialist, you will support our clients during their first months of working with Partnerize through platform training, onboarding their partners, preparing their programme and consulting on best practices. These customers will be primarily in the hiring region but may also be global. Therefore, customer\-focused experience (minimum 2 years) and project management skills will be key to be successful.



You will help in supporting internal and customer\-facing projects to improve the onboarding experience, support existing customers and provide training to new customers and internal teams, while supporting junior members of the team.


**Core Responsibilities:**


* **Conducting onboarding meetings**:
* + Responsible for scheduling and conducting onboarding calls or meetings with new customers.
	+ During these sessions, you will introduce the customer to the onboarding process, provide guidance on how to get started, and answer any questions the customer may have.
* **Managing the onboarding process**:
* + Responsible for managing the non\-technical aspects of the onboarding process for new customers, from initial contact to successful training and handover.
	+ This will involve coordinating with multiple teams, such as customer success or technical onboarding, to ensure a smooth onboarding experience.
* **Reporting**: Responsible for ensuring internal reports within Salesforce are updated on a regular cadence and highlighting any potential risks
* **Partner Migration**: Assisting clients migrate partners onto Partnerize from another provider
* **Onboarding Support / Training**:
* + Responsible for coordination and actioning platform support tasks on behalf of the client prior to launch (E.g uploading of creative assets/configuration of commission rules)
	+ Conducting training sessions on how to use the Partnerize Platform
	+ Creating documentation for both internal and external use

  




* **Team management:**
	+ Providing guidance and training to junior members of the team
	+ Ensure your team meet the agreed SLAs/KPIs
  


**Required Qualifications \& Skills:**


* Client or customer support experience (minimum 2 years)
* Project management experience
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical information to a non\-technical audience
* Teamwork, strong work ethic and enthusiasm to learn
* Strong attention to detail
* Strong prioritisation and organisational skills
* Strong interpersonal and soft skills
* Comprehensive computer literacy
* Problem\-solving skills

  


**Desired Skills:**


* Ability to present and lead meetings confidently
* Proficient in using Excel / Google Sheets to manipulate data (E.g formulas)
* Experience in conducting training sessions
* Experience in digital marketing
* Experience writing guides and training material
* Marketing, Advertising or Business degree
* Team coordination experience

  


**US Benefits \& Perks**


* Flexible Time Off Policy – Take the time you need
* Enhanced Parental Leave: 16 weeks for birth parent, 8 weeks for non\-birth parent at full pay after one year employment
* Robust Company Sponsored Health \& Welfare Benefits
* 401k Plan – 4% employee match
* Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching \& Wellness Programs
* Regular company events and activities

**Our Commitment to Diversity \& Inclusion**



We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.


**Privacy and data protection**. The data collected as part of this application will be used for the recruitment process and any subsequent employment. You can find further information in Partnerize privacy policy here: https://partnerize.com/privacy\-policy/


**Notice to Recruiters and Staffing Agencies:** To protect the interests of all parties, Partnerize will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate or an approved vendor that has a written and signed agreement in place with Partnerize. Please do not contact or forward resumes to our company employees or locations. Any unsolicited resumes will be considered Partnerize property. Partnerize is not responsible for any charges or fees related to unsolicited resumes.

jobs.title: Customer Success Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Reliable Premium Management (RPM)**

Reliable Premium Management (RPM) is a Pay As You Go workers' compensation payments partner trusted by 10,000\+ growing businesses in addition to agents, carriers and every major payroll provider nationwide. RPM connects directly with payroll providers and insurance carriers, so premiums stay accurate, payments stay predictable, and customers never face a year\-end surprise. Built on a simple belief – that workers' compensation should be simple, seamless and stress\-free – RPM delivers that experience through real people who genuinely care. As RPM continues to grow, the team behind that experience is everything.

**Location:** Waite Park, MN \| Full\-Time \| Non\-Exempt \| In\-office/Hybrid (4 days in office, 1 day remote available 90 days after start date)

**Pay:** $22 – $24/hour

**Role Mission**

This role exists to ensure every RPM customer begins their journey with clarity and confidence — transforming the complexity of workers' compensation into a seamless, supported experience that builds the foundation for long\-term success — while also showing up as a reliable teammate for the broader Customer Success team's day\-to\-day call coverage.

**Role Summary**

The Customer Success Onboarding Specialist at Reliable Premium Management is responsible for guiding new customers through a smooth, confidence\-building starts with RPM — managing a portfolio of active onboarding accounts through outbound calls and email from first contact to handoff. This role is built for someone who's organized, personable, and comfortable managing a high volume of accounts and calls while staying warm and clear with every customer.

Onboarding is the primary focus of this role, but it isn't the whole job. Because this position sits within the broader Customer Success team, you'll also take transferred and inbound calls, answer general customer inquiries, and take part in phone triage on an ongoing basis — so no two days look exactly the same.

This role works closely with the Manager, Customer Onboarding, and partners with the Account Services team, the Payment Operations team, and the broader Customer Success team — including Customer Support Specialists — to help deliver RPM's promise of a seamless, stress\-free experience from day one and every day after.

If you're energized by helping someone feel confident from their very first call, and you don't mind wearing more than one hat on a given day, this role was built for you.

**What Success Looks Like**

You know you're succeeding when:

* Your portfolio of 50\+ active onboarding accounts stays on schedule, with no account going dark or falling behind
* You conduct 70\+ outbound onboarding calls per week, with no customer going more than one week without proactive outreach
* Your Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT) holds at 4 or above, and emails are answered within one business day
* Account setup/billing discrepancies stay under 5%, with onboarding notes clean enough for teammates to pick up an inbound call without missing context
* You're a dependable presence on phone triage and general inquiries, helping the broader Customer Success team keep call coverage strong

**Key Responsibilities**

**Onboarding Execution \& Account Ownership**

* Manage a portfolio of 50\+ active onboarding accounts simultaneously, keeping each on schedule through the onboarding process
* Serve as the primary point of contact for new customers — conducting 70\+ outbound calls per week (capped at 2 calls per customer per week) plus email communication to guide them through each stage
* Educate customers on the complexities of workers' compensation and RPM's value, building trust and confidence at every touchpoint
* Analyze and interpret payroll reports across varying formats, catching discrepancies before they affect billing

**Ongoing Customer Support \& Phone Triage**

* Take transferred and inbound calls for the broader Customer Success team, answering general customer inquiries as they come in
* Serve as part of the team's phone triage rotation, routing or resolving calls so customers reach the right person quickly
* Provide professional, efficient phone and email support outside your own onboarding portfolio, in service of the team's overall coverage
* Surface customer trends and recurring questions in team meetings so the broader team can act on them

**Documentation \& Collaboration**

* Maintain accurate, detailed account notes and documentation for a clean, confident handoff to the Account Services team and Payment Operations team
* Collaborate with Customer Support Specialists and Seniors to ensure a consistent experience across the customer lifecycle
* Bring a continuous improvement mindset — identify and act on ways to strengthen the onboarding experience

**Who Thrives in This Role**

This role is ideal for someone who:

* Is organized enough to manage 50\+ moving accounts without letting anyone fall behind
* Is energized by talking to customers — whether it's a scheduled onboarding call or an inbound question that just came in
* Is comfortable switching between a structured onboarding cadence and the unpredictability of phone triage
* Takes pride in making a new customer's first experience with RPM feel easy

**RPM Culture Principles (How This Role Shows Up)**

**Own the Outcome**

Treats every account on your portfolio, and every call you pick up for the team, like the outcome is personally on you.

**Get Curious**

Digs into why a customer has a question instead of just answering it and moving on.

**Win Together**

Works closely with the Account Services team, the Payment Operations team, and the broader Customer Success team to keep every customer's experience seamless.

**Physical Demands**

* Extended periods of sitting at a desk
* Extended periods of computer, keyboard, and screen use
* Ability to communicate clearly by phone and email for extended periods
* Primarily sedentary work in an office setting
* Minimal lifting

**What We Offer**

* Hands\-on training on RPM's in\-house proprietary platform — no prior experience needed
* Quarterly bonus program
* 100% employer\-paid medical, dental, vision, life, AD\&D, and short\-term disability insurance
* 401(k) with 4% company match
* Competitive paid time off
* Two paid 15\-minute rest breaks daily, plus a paid 30\-minute meal break
* Flexibility and trust to manage your work
* A unique, people\-centered culture rooted in ownership, transparency, and learning
* Growth opportunities as the company scales

**Requirements**

The qualifications below describe what typically sets someone up for success in this role — they're a guide, not a strict checklist. A candidate who doesn't check every box but brings the right attitude, judgment, and drive is still encouraged to apply.

**Core Capabilities**

* Strong organizational skills — comfortable managing a high\-volume portfolio without letting anything fall behind
* Clear, warm, and confident phone and email communication
* Sound judgment — knowing when to follow the Playbook and when a situation needs a tailored response
* Comfort analyzing payroll reports and catching discrepancies
* General comfort with technology — able to pick up new systems and tools independently, including in\-house/proprietary platforms beyond standard Microsoft Office Suite

**Experience \& Background**

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel) required
* Prior experience in a customer\-facing role such as customer service, account management, or onboarding
* Comfort with high\-volume outbound and inbound phone communication
* No prior experience with our in\-house proprietary platform required — hands\-on training is provided

**Preferred/Highly Desirable**

* Prior experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM/customer communication platform
* Experience in insurance, workers' compensation, payroll, or a related service industry
* Experience with both outbound (proactive) and inbound (reactive) customer phone support

**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**

Reliable Premium Management (RPM) is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. RPM is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and employment.

Pay: $22\.00 \- $24\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Are you authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship?
* Are you able to work on\-site in Waite Park, MN
* What is your desired compensation?
* Are you comfortable working in a regulated industry where accuracy and compliance are critical?

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: EHR Support Specialist
jobs.description:
Description:
**POSITION TITLE:** EHR Support Specialist

**FLSA CLASSIFICATION:** Non\-Exempt

**POSITION OVERVIEW:** The Electronic Health Record Support Specialist assists with accurate, efficient, and compliant use of the agency electronic health record (EHR) system. The position maintains EHR information and documentation tools, monitors documentation workflows and quality, provides routine user support and training, and assists with system testing, reporting, and implementation activities.


**ESSENTIAL POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Core Job Functions \& Essential Tasks**

* Enters, updates, and maintains information and other assigned data within the EHR.
* Builds and maintains electronic forms, templates, assessments, and documentation tools within the EHR.
* Updates forms and workflows to reflect regulatory, payer, agency, and operational changes; documents changes and tests functionality before deployment.
* Monitors documentation workflows for completeness, missing information, and required documentation.

**Administrative \& Operational Support**

* Generates routine reports and import/export files to assist with data, quality, and compliance initiatives.
* Maintains EHR documentation manuals, training resources, records, and other system documentation.
* Supports user\-account maintenance and password resets within assigned access and security protocols.
* Assists with maintaining accurate information and documentation practices consistent with agency policy, payer requirements, CARF standards, HIPAA, 42 CFR Part 2, and applicable regulations.

**Requests, Service \& Responsiveness**

* Serves as the first point of contact for EHR questions and assists users with navigating system issues.
* Troubleshoots basic EHR issues and appropriately escalates technical, privacy, or security concerns.
* Provides introductory EHR training as well as training on workflows and documentation standards.
* Develops quick\-reference guides, job aids, and training materials for users of varying computer proficiency.

**Projects \& Special Assignments**

* Assists with testing new EHR functionality, forms, templates, and workflows before implementation.
* Participates in EHR implementation projects and supports deployment of new features and processes.
* Collaborates with departments to improve documentation efficiency and reinforce agency standards.

**Departmental \& Organizational Support**

* Notifies staff of documentation deficiencies and supports timely follow\-up and correction processes.
* Attends meetings related to EHR use, data and documentation, workflows, and system implementation.
* Supports MHA’s mission through accurate records, responsive service, confidentiality, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Complies with HIPAA, 42 CFR Part 2, payer, and regulatory requirements.

**ORGANIZATION STANDARDS:**

Demonstrates clear, respectful, and professional communication in both verbal and written interactions, with a focus on collaboration and solution\-oriented dialogue. Shares information responsibly and addresses concerns constructively while maintaining a positive, professional demeanor—even in challenging situations.

**Time \& Priority Management**


Effectively manages workload by prioritizing tasks, planning proactively, and addressing challenges to meet deadlines and responsibilities. Maintains a solution\-focused approach and professional composure while balancing competing priorities.

**Reliability \& Accountability \& Ownership**


Demonstrates dependability by consistently meeting commitments, deadlines, and responsibilities while taking ownership of work and outcomes. Acts with integrity, follows through on obligations, and addresses mistakes proactively to support a culture of accountability and trust.

**Adaptability and Change Agility**


Demonstrates adaptability by embracing new processes, priorities, and organizational changes with resilience and a willingness to learn. Adjusts work approaches as needed and supports others through change with a constructive, solution\-focused mindset.

**Organizational Alignment and Mission Focus**


Demonstrates behaviors aligned with the organization’s mission, values, and professional standards while supporting goals and initiatives through actions and attitude. Consistently follows policies and ethical guidelines, maintains confidentiality, and contributes to a culture of professionalism, respect, and service.

* High school diploma/GED required; relevant associate degree preferred.
* One year of administrative, healthcare, or customer\-service experience preferred.

jobs.title: Change Management Specialist (Slack Implementation)
jobs.description:
**Change Management Specialist (Slack Implementation)**

**Federal Agency Slack Rollout**

**Pay:** $130,000\.00 – $135,000\.00 per year

Full\-Time \| Remote (occasional in\-person as needed)

**About Us**

At Kavant Solutions, our mission is to support federal, state, and local government organizations with high\-quality IT services rooted in security, innovation, and accountability. We work alongside public sector leaders to advance modernization initiatives, strengthen operational resilience, and deliver measurable results for the communities they serve.

**About the Role**

Kavant is leading the implementation of Slack as the new enterprise collaboration platform for a large federal agency, and we're looking for a hands\-on Change Management Specialist to drive the people side of this rollout day to day. This isn't a support role bolted onto an IT project — you'll be in the details, building and executing the plans, materials, and touchpoints that help thousands of federal employees move off legacy communication tools and adopt Slack with confidence.

You'll work hand\-in\-hand with Delivery and Program Management to keep change activities synced to the Slack implementation timeline, and directly with agency leadership, program offices, and end users to build sponsorship, communication, training, and — critically — a rollout that gets people genuinely excited to use Slack instead of falling back on email and other legacy channels.

**What You'll Do**

Change Strategy \& Planning

* Develop a comprehensive organizational change management (OCM) plan for the Slack rollout, aligned to the implementation timeline from kickoff through post\-go\-live stabilization.
* Conduct stakeholder analysis and change impact assessments across program offices, regional teams, and end\-user groups to understand current communication habits and workflows.
* Apply structured change methodologies (e.g., Prosci ADKAR, Kotter's 8\-Step Process) to shape the overall change approach for the Slack transition.
* Define success metrics for Slack adoption — active usage, channel engagement, migration off legacy tools — and build a measurement plan to track them pre\- and post\-launch.

Rollout Planning \& Execution

* Design a phased Slack rollout plan (pilot group, wave\-based deployment by office/division, or agency\-wide launch) tailored to the agency's structure, risk tolerance, and operational calendar.
* Build a detailed go\-live playbook covering workspace/channel structure decisions, readiness checkpoints, cutover communications, hypercare support, and contingency/rollback plans.
* Coordinate rollout logistics with Delivery and Program Management to keep change activities synchronized with technical milestones (workspace provisioning, integrations, data migration, UAT, etc.).
* Establish a command\-center/hypercare model for the go\-live window, including escalation paths for user issues and Slack\-specific troubleshooting.

Stakeholder Engagement \& Communications

* Develop and execute a multi\-channel communication plan tailored to distinct audiences — executive sponsors, program managers, front\-line staff, and IT support teams — explaining what Slack is, why it's replacing current tools, and what's changing for them.
* Support agency sponsors and leadership in visible, active sponsorship, including drafting talking points and town hall materials that model using Slack themselves.
* Build a change agent/champion network embedded across offices and divisions — often Slack's earliest and most active users — to extend reach, gather ground\-level feedback, and reinforce adoption.
* Create a project narrative and key messaging framework that clearly answers "what's changing, why Slack, and what's in it for me" for every stakeholder group.

Marketing \& Branding for the Rollout

* Develop an internal campaign name, visual identity, and launch concept for the Slack rollout (e.g., a memorable internal name, logo, and tagline) to build recognition and reduce "just another government system" fatigue.
* Design a pre\-launch teaser campaign (countdown emails, posters/digital signage for agency locations, intranet banners) to build anticipation ahead of go\-live.
* Produce a consistent visual toolkit — templates for emails, slide decks, digital signage, and printed materials, plus in\-Slack assets (welcome messages, channel banners, emoji/branding) — so every touchpoint reinforces the same look, tone, and message.
* Plan launch\-day and launch\-week engagement moments (kickoff event, leadership video message, Slack\-based scavenger hunts or challenges, swag/recognition for early adopters, etc.) appropriate for a federal agency environment.
* Maintain an internal "hub" (SharePoint site, intranet page, or a dedicated Slack channel) as the single source of truth for FAQs, training resources, and rollout updates.

Training \& Adoption

* Design a tiered training strategy (role\-based training, train\-the\-trainer, self\-paced e\-learning, live workshops) to build end\-user proficiency on Slack — channels, messaging etiquette, integrations, and search.
* Develop job aids, quick\-reference guides, video walkthroughs, and other adoption support materials tailored to Slack's features and the agency's approved use cases.
* Coordinate a training delivery schedule aligned to each rollout wave, including scheduling, room/platform logistics, and attendance tracking.
* Track and report Slack adoption and utilization metrics before and after go\-live, and adjust training/support based on gaps.

Resistance Management \& Readiness

* Conduct organizational readiness assessments ahead of each go\-live milestone.
* Identify sources of resistance (workflow disruption, skill gaps, cultural/procedural friction) and design targeted mitigation strategies.
* Support agency leadership in addressing adoption barriers as they surface, including facilitated feedback sessions with resistant groups.

Program \& Client Management

* Serve as the day\-to\-day change management point of contact for the agency engagement.
* Coordinate with Delivery and Program Management to align change activities with technical implementation milestones.
* Report on change management progress, risks, and adoption metrics to both Kavant leadership and client stakeholders on a regular cadence.

Business Development Support

* Support proposal development and discovery conversations when future opportunities include change management scope, in coordination with the Growth Lead.
* Provide OCM\-specific input on estimates, staffing, and work plans for relevant proposals, drawing on lessons learned from this engagement.

Professional Expectations

* General office hours are Monday–Friday, 9am–5pm, with willingness to work outside those hours for deadlines, go\-live events, and time\-sensitive matters.
* Maintain a professional, respectful, and solution\-oriented approach in all interactions.
* Communicate proactively about priorities, progress, risks, and blockers; raise concerns early.
* Respond to emails, messages, and requests within 24 business hours.
* Take ownership of assigned responsibilities and follow through on commitments.
* Demonstrate initiative by identifying opportunities for improvement and bringing forward solutions.
* Protect confidential client, employee, contract, and company information at all times.

**Qualifications**

* 5\+ years of experience in organizational change management, ideally supporting government or public sector technology implementations.
* Direct experience supporting a Slack rollout or similar collaboration\-platform implementation (e.g., Microsoft Teams, Google Workspace) strongly preferred.
* Certification in a recognized change management methodology (e.g., Prosci Change Management Certification, ACMP Certified Change Management Professional (CCMP), or equivalent) strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience applying structured change frameworks (ADKAR, Kotter's 8\-Step, Bridges' Transition Model, or similar) to technology or process implementations.
* Experience developing and executing stakeholder communication plans, training strategies, and adoption measurement approaches.
* Experience building internal marketing/branding campaigns for a system launch or major organizational initiative is a strong plus.
* Familiarity with federal or state government environments and the change dynamics specific to public sector organizations — civil service culture, procurement cycles, and multi\-layered stakeholder approval.
* Strong facilitation and executive\-communication skills; comfortable coaching senior agency sponsors.
* Working knowledge of Slack (channels, workspaces, integrations, admin settings) is required; familiarity with additional workplace and IT tools (e.g., Tableau, SharePoint, MS Teams) is a plus for supporting communication, reporting, and adoption tracking.
* PMP, Prosci, or CCMP certification a plus.

**Benefits**

* 401(k)
* 401 (k) matching
* Paid Time Off

**Work Location:** Remote, with occasional in\-person presence needed (Washington, DC area)
